original_content_full: The paper "Service-based Analysis and Abstractionfor Content Moderation of Digital Images" by Moritz Hilscher, Hendrik Tjabben, Hendrik Rätz, Amir Semmo, Lonni Besancon, Jürgen Döllner, and Matthias Trapp was accepted for publication and presentation at the renowned GRAPHICS INTERFACE conference. The conference is held virtually from May 27th to May 28th. More information at https://graphicsinterface.org/conference/2021/.
